offering_description.value: Provides outpatient mental health care, including psychotherapy and psychiatric medication management, through clinician-led clinics and virtual visits. Patients are served directly and insurers and government programs reimburse most visits, with some self-pay.

primary_services.value: outpatient psychotherapy; psychiatric evaluation and medication management; virtual therapy visits; psychological testing

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients seeking therapy and psychiatric care for mental health conditions; B2B: commercial health insurance payers and employer health plans; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: insurance and government program payments for therapy and psychiatry visits; service fees: self-pay patient fees for visits not covered by insurance

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers mental health visits by employed and contracted clinicians, sold to patients and billed to payers

geography_served.value: US national: operates clinics and virtual care across many US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: outpatient mental health care only, spanning therapy and psychiatry

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated outpatient mental health clinics; online: virtual therapy and psychiatry visits by video or phone; partners / resellers: insurance networks and employer benefit programs that refer members

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state licensing of clinics and clinicians, DEA registration for controlled prescriptions, Medicare and Medicaid rules, HIPAA privacy

notes: Business mix and size judgments are based on general knowledge and may have changed.
